rejected_aggregates.reason: Each is a region-wide, cumulative engagement-pipeline snapshot for the quarter to date, not an individual engagement — the deals that make it up (including Trailhead Logistics's own) are already represented by their own business_unit rows. Counting these as deals would double-count.

meta.note_on_totals: The three finance-section pipeline figures are overlapping, cumulative snapshots of the same regional pipeline over time, not three separate amounts — summing them would overcount by roughly a factor of three. Coverage for this range is also only 4 of 9 periods (44.4%, see coverage.json), so no total is computed here regardless of that.
